remarks: An Exceptional Opportunity to Create Your Dream Home! Nestled in coveted Shippan Point, this .35-acre level lot offers a rare chance to build or renovate your ideal residence with breathtaking views of Long Island Sound and deeded beach rights. Whether you dream of a sleek, modern retreat with expansive glass walls or a shore colonial, this prime location provides the perfect canvas for your vision. Enjoy the serene beauty of Westcott Cove and embrace the vibrant waterfront lifestyle that Shippan Point is renowned for. Just 7 minutes from Metro-North and the bustling heart of downtown, this prestigious neighborhood is home to some of the area's most beautiful properties. Don't miss the chance to make this exceptional location your own!
